task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding

evidence.quote: Video Moment Retrieval (MR) seeks to locate specific time segments within an untrimmed video based on a natural language query describing an event, requiring the model to effectively understand the video content and precisely capture the transient details relevant to the query.
